record.label: Preparing interaction weights by counting basis states
record.statement: A reversible classical circuit assigns basis states from a uniform superposition to interaction terms in proportion to their weights. For electron–nucleus terms the weights are proportional to $Z_i$, and the same construction applies to every coefficient of the linear combination.
record.boundary: If an electron–nucleus pair with nuclear charge $Z_i$ receives $Z_i$ times as many basis states as an otherwise comparable pair with unit charge, it also receives $Z_i$ times the weight in the linear combination. Lean checks these multiplicities in the decoder and bounds the error of the resulting Hamiltonian block.
